target.scope: unified forward inference: chunk prefill, indexed recurrent/MTP, fused-gate packed decode

sources.role: shape and harness reference; adapt gate/state semantics

common.g_beta: precomputed outside recurrent timing; match pinned vLLM gate dtypes and formulas
common.input_layout: actual post-convolution split QKV views from pinned model path
common.state_pool: distinct valid request slots, noncontiguous permutation, capacity at least max(1024, required slots plus reserved slots)
common.padding: primary suite all valid; graph padding in regression suite

ordinary_decode.state_semantics: load historical cache; write updated state and output; preserve unrelated slots

speculative_decode.state_semantics: select prior state using accepted-token metadata and preserve all per-token snapshots required by target ABI

cases: graph padded slots with -1 and reserved 0 according to pinned ABI
different accepted-token counts including supported boundaries
contiguous QKV versus actual strided QKV
unmodified cache slots checked with sentinels
multiple consecutive calls and one-shot versus stepwise outputs/states
float16 inputs and bfloat16 state where supported
K/V=64 or 256 and K!=V where public API promises support

providers: FLA on equivalent common semantics only
measurement.cache_regimes: report warm and cold separately; do not assert either is a measured production distribution
measurement.state_mutation: identical starting states for correctness; audit replay/tuner mutation and use same explicit state lifecycle for each provider
measurement.precision: preserve target state precision; do not lower precision for speed

reporting.primary: ordinary decode and speculative decode reported separately, grouped by model-head ratio and TP; show each latency and worst regression
reporting.trace_note: Static source proves model geometry, not deployment market share or runtime frequency. Representative service traces determine probabilities and call coverage.

preconditions: pin model config revisions and library commits before runs
verify each chosen deployment's TP sharding and model dtype/quantization feasibility separately from per-rank kernel microbenchmark
audit whether target operator is actually called; separately fused/packed paths must not be attributed to pure recurrent speedups
all correctness assertions pass before timing
freeze and checksum expanded case list before tuning; append cases rather than remove regressions

prefill.notes: No production-frequency weighting. Include short/small-head and dimension fallback cases; fast path requires existing Hopper guard.
